explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem is an extensionality principle for algebra maps out of the library's own field `FB Γ`: two `Qbar`-algebra maps `φ, ψ` are equal if they agree on all quotients of integral q-expansions of modular forms. The proof applies Mathlib's generic `IntermediateField.algHom_ext_of_eq_adjoin` (in Mathlib/FieldTheory/IntermediateField/Adjoin/Defs.lean). That lemma only says that algebra maps out of `adjoin F s` are determined by their values on `s`, which is a generic ext principle. The real content is the library's own `FB_eq_adjoin Γ`, which shows `FB Γ` is generated by those quotients. Mathlib has no notion of `FB`, `IsIntegralQExp`, `intSeriesC` or `coeffEmb`, so it cannot contain this statement.
